name: Swiss International
oneLiner: Strict columns, flush-left Helvetica, one signal red, and rules instead of shadows — clarity as a moral position.

effects.grid: 12-column grid, 8px baseline, 2px gutters rendered as visible rules when the layout is the subject

motion.reducedMotion: instant state change with a 1px underline appearing on focus; motion is optional in this style

primary.base: height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accent-text); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0; border: 0

outline.base: height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-text); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500

rule.base: padding: 24px; border-radius: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); border: 0; border-top: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-border); box-shadow: none

default.base: height: 44px; padding: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 1rem

bar.base: height: 64px; padding: 0 32px; background: var(--uiux-color-bg); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-border); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em

default.base: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.875rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
default.header: text-align: left; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-border); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase

default.base: height: 20px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 500

do: Build on a visible 12-column grid; let the alignment itself be the decoration.
Set one enormous flush-left headline and keep the rest small and dense.
Use rules, counters, and negative space to separate content.
Use exactly one accent color, and only for the single most important action or datum on screen.
dont: Do not round corners or add drop shadows; elevation is a mismatch.
Do not center anything except a deliberate poster composition.
Do not introduce a second accent hue; status colors stay functional and rare.
Do not letter-space lowercase body text.
antiPatterns: Grid layout with rounded cards and soft shadows — the style's whole argument disappears.
Red used on five elements so nothing reads as primary.
Centered hero with a serif headline and pastel gradient background.

notes: Black rules on white are strong; keep secondary text at 7:1 so the hierarchy survives the density.
Never encode the single accent's meaning by color alone; pair it with weight or a rule.
Focus must be a visible 2px outline, not a color change, because the palette is monochrome.
